prompt: the open fridge as a tabletop diorama, the night after the feast: glass shelves, the door swung wide with its bins of bottles, the light on inside and cold mist rolling out; the leftovers come off the counter one at a time (a pie half, a tray of stuffing, a gravy jar, the foil-wrapped turkey, a cranberry tub, a casserole, a stack of rolls, the mashed potatoes), each a low-poly dish of a few blocks; aim the next one, turn it and drop it onto a shelf, where it rests on what is under it; cover a shelf and it glows; anything sticking out past the door line gets bumped by the door and wobbles, and three bumps mean the door won't close: THE FRIDGE WINS
